page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page. No marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left, catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: in his coactus sit fateri, Christum esse unum illum Deum, qui omnia creavit; aut certe ex illius propria substantia genitum; atque adeo non esse Creaturam, nudumque Hominem, qui non extitit, antequam ex B. V. Maria natus esset; (quod alibi toties affirmat, variisque Argumentis, quantum in se est, propugnat) sed etiam, & multo magis, quod hoc afferere cogatur ex Authoritate veterum Ecclesiae Doctorum, qui (ut verissime inquit) nimis aperte in S. Scriptura ea Chri-sto tribui animadverterunt, quae soli Deo tribui consueverunt; &, inter caetera, potissimum Adorationem & Invocationem. Unde & Eum obnixe rogat, ne manifestissimae Veritati quicquam repugnare velit. Porro, constet modo sibi Socinus Illiusque Discipuli Magistri sui Dictatis auscultare velint, ut ad eandem Regulam caetera sua Dogmata examinari patiantur, riteque sic examinata ad Illam conformentur, neque aliud, neque amplius quidquam ab eis petimus. Sed quis non videt, ex hoc Concessio[?], totum Socinianismum illico ruiturum, & abolitum iri ex Ecclesia; nimirum si Interpretatio S. Scripturae ab antiquis Patribus allata, qui Fidem Christianam Pietate simul ac Doctrina adornarunt, & Martyrio insuper confirmarunt, pro vera & Authentica accipienda sit; & si Omnes Interpretationem eam oppugnantes, in manifestissima Veritate oculos claudant.

page.notes: Printed page 58 with running head. The right edge of the scan shows only the neighbouring page and show-through, which are left out. The reading "Concessio" is doubtful (the scan looks like "Conceslo"). The section number "4o." is hard to read. The catchword "juscunque" is at the lower right. The hyphenated words "Chri-sto", "astru-endis" and "manife-stissima" are kept with their printed hyphens, but in the final paragraph the ending "astru-" was misplaced: the scan reads "ad quas angustias ... suis astru-endis", which is transcribed above with the hyphen at the line end.
